section.title: QuickPick Class Reference
Detailed Description
section.para: The QuickPick class provides functionalities for managing and installing various modules within the Bearsampp application. It includes methods for retrieving available modules, fetching module versions, parsing release properties, and validating license keys.

getQuickpickMenu() getQuickpickMenuQuickPick QuickPickgetQuickpickMenu getQuickpickMenu (array $modules, array $versions, string $imagesPath) Generates the HTML content for the QuickPick menu. This method creates the HTML structure for the QuickPick interface, including a dropdown for selecting modules and their respective versions. It checks if the license key is valid before displaying the modules. If the license key is invalid, it displays a subscription prompt. If there is no internet connection, it displays a message indicating the lack of internet.
